title: Darksome
description: This mod makes the pale garden harder by adding new abilities to the creaking and adding new content to the pale garden.
body:
DARKSOME



Darksome is a mod that add on to the pale garden, this mod adds all new weapons and utility to the game.



Features

This mod adds two new weapons and a new movment item. This mod also adds a new food and a new effect.



Buffs

This mod buffs the creaking and make it deal over 20 hearts of damage and it gives a speacial new effect on hit.
